snippet.title: 3D Action Game 'Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread' Latest Gameplay Trailer [holo Indie] #hololive
snippet.description:
Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread is a 3D action game starring Gawr Gura from hololive English -Myth-.
Players control Gura as she embarks on a quest to recover her missing favorite bread. Overcome challenging battles against blocking enemies and bosses, navigate precise platforming stages, and solve brain-teasing puzzle mechanics.
